newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus bank worker embezzled $1m to bet, police.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus bank worker embezzled $1m to bet, police.

text.p: An employee of the Cyprus Popular Bank was detained on Wednesday on suspicion of embezzling more than a million dollars from the bank to bet on soccer matches, police said.
The suspect, from the southern coastal town of Limassol, was on Wednesday remanded for eight days in custody pending police inquiries.
His bank manager has claimed an accounts discrepancy of 520,000 Cyprus pounds ($1.05 million) which was traced back to the suspect, police said.
Police told the court that the suspect confessed to using the money to bet on British soccer games.
"Bank clients run no risk of losing their deposits," Popular Bank spokesman Andreas Stylianou said.
